free_tier_limits: Free public resolver with no published normal-use quota; unusual high-rate or abusive traffic may be rate-limited.
resolution_notes: Auditor correct on pricing.free_tier_limits. Official 1.1.1.1 / DoH docs present it as free public use without a published normal quota, but Cloudflare documents that abusive, high-rate, or non-typical traffic can be rate-limited—so "unlimited" is too absolute. Evidence: https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/encryption/dns-over-https/ and related 1.1.1.1 privacy/terms pages noting fair-use / anti-abuse limits.
